node.title: TeamPCP Campaign Spreads to npm via a Hijacked Bitwarden CLI
node.excerpt: JFrog security researchers identified a hijacked npm package published as @bitwarden/cli version 2026.4.0, impersonating the legitimate Bitwarden command line client.

node.title: TeamPCP strikes again: Xinference PyPI package compromised
node.excerpt: The JFrog security research team recently identified a supply chain attack targeting the `xinference` package on PyPI. Versions 2.6.0, 2.6.1, and 2.6.2 were compromised and yanked by maintainers after users reported suspicious behavior. If you installed or imported these versions, you must assume your environment is compromised.

node.description: Meitar Palas and Shavit Satou, JFrog Security Researchers
node.title: Astral Injection: From Fake VideoGame to XWorm RAT via npm and Discord
node.excerpt: JFrog Security researchers have discovered a multi-vector malware campaign distributing the XWorm RAT through both npm packages and a fake game website, targeting Discord users with social engineering tactics.

node.title: hermes-px: The 'Privacy' AI Proxy That Steals Your Prompts, Containing Altered Claude Code System Prompt
node.excerpt: A malicious PyPI package disguised as a Tor-routed AI proxy abuses a Tunisian university's private AI infrastructure, bundles a stolen 246K-character Anthropic Claude system prompt, and silently exfiltrates every user prompt and response to the attacker's Supabase database.

node.title: Cross-Platform Threat - Axios Package Compromise
node.excerpt: The JFrog security research team recently identified a supply chain attack targeting the `axios` npm package. If you installed `axios@1.14.1`, or `axios@0.30.4` you must assume your environment is compromised.

node.title: LofyGang Returns: From Fake undici to Full System Compromise via Parallel Data Theft
node.excerpt: The JFrog Security research team identified a malicious npm package undicy-http (version 2.0.0) masquerading as the popular undici HTTP client library. Despite its name, the package contains zero HTTP client functionality.

node.title: TeamPCP strikes again - telnyx popular PyPI library compromised
node.excerpt: On March 27th, the telnyx popular PyPI library was compromised. new versions of telnyx were uploaded to PyPI, 4.87.1 and 4.87.2. Both contains malicous payload, this compromise is linked to TeamPCP

node.description: Aviv Engelberg and Ofri Ouzan, JFrog Security Researchers
node.title: Langflow CVE-2026-33017: Latest 'fixed' version is still exploitable
node.excerpt: The JFrog Security Research team has identified that Langflow version 1.8.2, which is widely reported as patched for CVE-2026-33017, remains vulnerable to remote code execution

node.description: Guy Korolevski and Andrii Polkovnychenko, JFrog Security Researchers
node.title: Popular litellm Python package is the latest victim of TeamPCP's ongoing supply chain attack
node.excerpt: On March 24th, the litellm popular PyPI library was compromised. new versions of litellm were uploaded to PyPI, 1.82.7 and 1.82.8. Both contains malicous payload, this compromise is linked to TeamPCP

node.title: New compromised versions detected in CanisterWorm attack
node.excerpt: JFrog Security researchers have identified new, previously unreported compromised package versions related to the CanisterWorm npm supply chain attack.
